headline: The heterotic/Clifford CZ-parity C6 lifts exactly through the 240-root E8 Coxeter fibration. An order-six E8 root automorphism L preserves the full Gram matrix, commutes with the internal fiber rotation d, induces CZ*parity on the 80-state signed-Pauli quotient, and satisfies L^3=d^3=-I. Therefore C=L d^-1 has order three and induces pure CZ, while d induces parity; <d,C> is C6 x C3 of order 18.
remaining_boundary: The witness depends on the frozen Coxeter-fiber/base/switching gauge. Existence and group relations are exact; coordinate canonicity is not claimed.
